name: Instant Knowledge Base – Documentation, Knowledge Base, Help Center & Wiki Resource Center
author: Seventh Sky

sections.description:
Instant Knowledge Base helps you publish a fast, organized WordPress knowledge base without building a documentation system from scratch. Create help articles, group them into hierarchical Help Topics, add searchable FAQs, and give visitors a clear path to the answer they need.

Use it for product documentation, customer support, SaaS onboarding, internal wikis, standard operating procedures, tutorials, troubleshooting guides, and frequently asked questions.

The Core plugin includes unlimited knowledge base articles and FAQs, three responsive layouts, AJAX live search, article feedback, access controls, basic analytics, custom ordering, and flexible display options. It works with classic and block themes and can be embedded with a shortcode.

A searchable help center for WordPress

Visitors can search documentation as they type, browse Help Topics, open related articles, and move through clear breadcrumb navigation. Responsive landing, category, and article templates keep documentation readable on desktops, laptops, tablets, and phones.

Three responsive knowledge base layouts

Choose the presentation that fits your content:

  • Default: A clean support hub with topic cards, popular articles, and a reading-focused article view.
  • Classic: A familiar documentation layout with structured navigation for larger help libraries.
  • Plain Index: A lightweight, text-first directory for simple documentation and internal knowledge bases.

Knowledge base articles and Help Topics

Create and manage documentation with a dedicated article post type. Use parent and child Help Topics to build a useful hierarchy, control topic visibility, show or hide empty topics, and manually order topics and articles.

WordPress FAQ plugin features

Enable the included FAQ system to publish searchable questions and answers. Organize FAQs into categories and output FAQ structured data for eligible content. Search engines determine whether rich results are displayed.

Built-in engagement tools

Measure article views, collect helpful or not-helpful feedback, review basic search and engagement summaries, and guide readers with popular and related articles.

Access and privacy controls

Require visitors to log in before viewing the knowledge base, or override access settings for individual articles. Optional consent controls are available for knowledge base analytics, and analytics can be disabled from the plugin settings.

Core Features

  • Unlimited articles, FAQs, and FAQ categories
  • Default, Classic, and Plain Index layouts
  • Responsive knowledge base, category, and article pages
  • Live search and search results
  • Hierarchical Help Topics and subtopics
  • Manual Help Topic and article ordering
  • Topic visibility and empty-topic controls
  • Breadcrumbs, related articles, popular articles, views, and feedback
  • Basic search and engagement analytics
  • Global and per-article login requirements
  • FAQ structured data and presentation settings
  • Floating search widget and import/export tools
  • Block-theme and classic-theme compatibility
  • Knowledge base shortcode: [instant_knowledgebase]
  • FAQ shortcode: [ikbase_faqs]

WALK-THROUGH: Instant Knowledge Base Tutorial

Learn how to install, activate, and configure your knowledge base with our easy step-by-step guide.

Instant Knowledge Base Pro

The free Core plugin is a complete knowledge base and remains fully functional without an upgrade. Instant Knowledge Base Pro is a separate add-on for businesses, agencies, and documentation teams that need more design control, richer editorial tools, multi-product organization, and deeper reporting.

What is included in Pro?

  • Premium layouts: Compact, Content Focus, Help Center Modern, Opt-in Focus, Knowledge Canvas, and other designed experiences.
  • Advanced analytics: Explore search terms, missing-content opportunities, engagement, article performance, funnels, and automated insights.
  • Product documentation: Organize one knowledge base around multiple products, brands, services, or platforms with product-specific landing pages and content filtering.
  • Advanced search interfaces: Add dropdown results, live suggestions, and richer search presentation options.
  • Hero and design controls: Customize hero backgrounds, colors, content, search presentation, typography, and branding in more detail.
  • Content Editor Tools: Insert code, content boxes, media, iFrames, interactive checklists, and single checks.
  • Knowledge base widget: Embed searchable documentation in more locations with the Pro widget shortcode.
  • Video tutorials section: Present product demos, walkthroughs, and training resources inside the help center.
  • Advanced integrations: Connect optional external analytics services and use additional export and reporting tools.
  • PDF exports: Export supported articles and analytics reports as PDFs.

Why upgrade to Pro?

Upgrade when your help center has outgrown one documentation structure or support decisions need more than basic totals. Pro helps teams:

  • Run documentation for several products from one WordPress site.
  • Match a knowledge base more closely to a company or client brand.
  • Discover unsuccessful searches and missing documentation topics.
  • Create richer tutorials and interactive onboarding workflows.
  • Improve access with widgets and advanced search.
  • Produce reports and exports for teams or clients.

Compare Instant Knowledge Base Pro features and plans

Support and Documentation

  • Knowledge base documentation
  • Instant Knowledge Base product page
  • Video tutorials
  • WordPress.org support forum
sections.installation:
Install from WordPress

  1. In the WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for Instant Knowledge Base.
  3. Select Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open Knowledge Base, create Help Topics and articles, then choose a layout in Settings.
sections.faq:
How do I display the knowledge base?

Use the plugin’s knowledge base pages or place [instant_knowledgebase] on a WordPress page or post.

Can I organize articles into categories and subcategories?

Yes. Help Topics are hierarchical, so you can create parent topics and nested subtopics. You can also control visibility and custom ordering.

Does the plugin include live search?

Yes. AJAX live search helps visitors find matching documentation without manually browsing every topic.

Can I restrict access to documentation?

Yes. You can require login globally and override that setting for individual knowledge base articles.

Can I add an FAQ section?

Yes. Enable FAQs in the settings, create FAQ categories and entries, or use the [ikbase_faqs] shortcode.

Does FAQ structured data guarantee rich results?

No. The plugin can output structured FAQ data for eligible content, but search engines decide whether and where rich results appear.

What analytics are included in Core?

Core includes article views, helpfulness feedback, total search activity, and basic admin summaries. Pro adds query-level reporting, funnels, deeper engagement analysis, automated insights, and additional integrations.

Is Pro required?

No. Core includes the article system, FAQs, search, layouts, access controls, basic analytics, ordering, and responsive templates. Pro is an optional separate add-on for advanced workflows and design requirements.

Where can I get support?

Use the plugin documentation, video tutorials, or the WordPress.org support forum.
